reason: Feature39 analytics capture, current-consent aggregation and dashboard; strict changed-work CI policy correction. This manifest is valid only for this work baseline, not a reusable permission to run unrelated historical suites.

quality.grep: (?:^| )keyless analytics dashboard fails closed without fabricated counts or business metrics$

enrollment-browser.grep: (?:^| )(?:(?:duplicate callbacks and concurrent confirm POSTs settle one first charge)|(?:toss_card_billing definitive decline grants no paid access and is not automatically retried)|(?:charge\-response\-lost stays held and reconciliation never recharges))$

renewal-browser.grep: (?:^| )(?:(?:toss_card_billing renewal at normal uses regular price once and preserves paid access))$

reconciliation-browser.grep: (?:^| )(?:(?:toss_card_billing lost initial response query recovery and read\-only admin at normal))$

reasons.unit: All 24 analytics test files directly cover the changed schemas, capture adapters/services, actor-bound HTTP/UI, current consent, source proof and migration. Ten direct changed-entrypoint contracts cover artists preview DTO, chat/read, reply/send, install completion, enrollment/renewal/reconciliation composition and cancellation; lint-boundaries covers edited ESLint boundaries. No full unit directory is selected.
reasons.fixtures: Only the new analytics isolated fixture/discovery guard and the edited CI planner, Git provenance, aggregate, workflow and exact-file runner contracts. Existing unrelated fixture matrices are not selected.
reasons.sql: Six analytics files only: four new capture/dashboard/isolation files plus the existing analytics consent/lifecycle/security source contracts. New capture tests already exercise source ownership, chronology and finance proof; no historical source-feature SQL chains are selected.
reasons.races: Two analytics scripts only: existing consent/dedupe source contract plus new current-authority/current-consent aggregate and capture lock interleavings.
reasons.upgrades: Only populated migration37→38 verifies new analytics storage and unchanged predecessor state. Earlier unrelated upgrades are not rerun.
reasons.browser.analytics-funnel-browser: All 19 cases are new changed-work dashboard/capture cases, including six font/width combinations and actual preview actor replacement.
reasons.browser.quality: Only one new keyless analytics fail-closed case; not the entire default browser discovery.
reasons.browser.enrollment-browser: Exactly three composition cases cover successful replay, persisted decline and owner-driven uncertain-result recovery after analytics decoration; no full provider matrices.
reasons.browser.renewal-browser: One normal-font provider-independent finalize composition smoke, not renewal pricing/retry/refund matrices.
reasons.browser.reconciliation-browser: One worker-driven initial recovery composition case, distinct from owner-driven recovery; not all reconciliation operations.
reasons.browser.cancellation-browser: One restricted-owner cancellation case proves optional analytics rejection never blocks the authorized cancellation result.
reasons.browser.chat-browser: One read replay case covers same-request analytics capability without changing receipts.
reasons.browser.reply-browser: One immutable send/replay case covers post-commit reply observation without changing operation identity.
reasons.browser.auth-browser: One repeated installation-completion case covers signup observation without changing source timestamp/access.
reasons.compile: Whole TypeScript graph compilation is needed for generated RPC and shared entrypoint type contracts; it does not execute regression tests. Production builds are used only to serve selected browser cases.

exclusions: No cumulative check:all, whole unit directory, all pgTAP files, all race scripts, all upgrade chain, or whole default/legacy browser suite.
Unchanged calendar, scheduling, community/moderation, attendance/rewards, media/compose/dispatch, notification/webpush, settlement and admin operations are outside this change.
No legacy artist discovery/session/profile/checkout suite: new preview/current-actor tests cover the changed behavior; auth mechanics themselves did not change.

No additional payment providers/fonts, refunds, retry budgets, Cron authentication or unrelated navigation matrices. Selected legacy browser cases are composition smokes, not evidence that their fixtures granted analytics consent.
Applying all migrations constructs the current schema; it is setup, not execution of all stored historical regression tests.
Full stored suites remain dormant until one explicitly designated predeployment run; none is authorized or executed by this feature plan.
